jobs.title: Senior Scientist, Production
jobs.descriptionPlain: Adaptyv is building an automated lab that lets AI agents run biology experiments. This is not a lab technician position: a senior scientist who owns assay quality, data QC and controls, and production troubleshooting across the experimental pipeline. Protein expression, binding assays, wet-lab biology.

jobs.title: Lab Operations Associate
jobs.descriptionPlain: A hands-on, in-the-lab role: reconstituting and aliquoting target proteins, buffer prep, plate handling, instrument maintenance and lab safety. Based in Lausanne, or willing to relocate.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Lab & Protein Data
jobs.descriptionPlain: Build the data science layer of our foundry: data quality, bioinformatics and dataset building. Strong Python and machine learning skills; you don't need to be a bench scientist.
